With a reputation for quality that spans two decades of experience, we know how to get repairs done right the first time while providing a seamless repair process for our customers. | BUMPER AND PANEL | At UCC we harness the latest technology, training, and skills to provide the industry’s leading bumper and panel repair service for every vehicle we encounter. At University Collision Center, we provide both the best tools, and most importantly, the right team to do the job correctly. Fender damage can range from a small dent to more serious harm. UCC of Gainesville, FL is equipped and ready to fix almost any type of damage to your vehicle. UCC Gainesville, FL uses the very latest computerized paint-matching software, so that each vehicle entering our booths precisely matches its original finish and color. All UCC painters are professionally trained and certified. Plus, we provide our painters with top quality refinishing products that are globally recognized and used by the best auto professionals in the industry. University Collision Center painters begin the process by making sure they’re working on a flawlessly clean surface, removing all dirt, grease, and other materials that get in the way of an immaculate finish. | HAIL DAMAGE REPAIR | Too often, there is no escaping nature’s wear and tear on vehicles, especially during hailstorms. Thankfully, University Collision Center specializes in cosmetic repairs and can remove any evidence that hail ever struck your vehicle.If your vehicle needs hail dent removal, bring it in to any UCC for our free auto body repair estimate. You’ll receive the assurance that our technicians understand the frustration of hail damage and possess the precision required to fix it correctly. With 40 years of repair experience, our technicians are experts in the latest and most effective techniques for dent repair. | AUTO PAINT REPAIR | Paint chips can result from rocks or gravel thrown up by a car in front of you, inclement weather, or from a collision. Luckily, the team at University Collision Center boasts the industry’s finest painters and staff to get your vehicle’s paint finish looking like new again. | COLLISION REPAIR | The original factory paint on most standard vehicles is flexible, meaning that minor dents can often be repaired without painting, depending on the depth and location of the damage.The process may also be ideal for hail damage and low impact dent repair.
